author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Why design does not translate: how different schools teach different ways of thinking
summary: American, Soviet, Bauhaus, Swiss, Polish, Japanese, Italian, Scandinavian and Dutch design differ not only in form. They answer the basic question of design in different ways: why should design exist at all?
